finding.claim: unifiedDiff does not handle the prefix case where start is -1 but lengths differ: it builds a header with 0 offsets and indexes beforeLines[-1], producing '-undefined' lines.
finding.title: unifiedDiff prefix insertion emits invalid diff with undefined

verifier.reason: The code at patch/index.mjs:152-159 returns early only when start===-1 and lengths are equal, otherwise uses start=-1 in the header (start+1=0) and loops from index=-1, so beforeLines[-1]/afterLines[-1] produce '-undefined'/'+undefined' when before is a prefix of after.

repro.expectedBehavior: unifiedDiff emits a valid diff for a changed line and, for a pure prefix insertion, emits only the added line with no undefined, no deletions of unchanged lines, and no 0 header offsets.
repro.rationale: Control uses a mid-file substitution where start != -1 and passes. Test uses before as a strict prefix of after (start === -1, lengths differ), which triggers indexing beforeLines[-1] and 0 offsets in the buggy code.
repro.reason: control passed 3/3 and the trigger failed 3/3 with an assertion error on the analyzed commit
